{{Current events|year=2019|month=04|day=29|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*A propaganda video featuring [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]] leader [[Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi]] is released, in which he references the [[2019 Sri Lanka Easter bombings]], indicating that he is still alive and that the video was shot very recently. It is the first time he's been seen on video since July 2014, when he addressed a crowd at the now destroyed [[Great Mosque of al-Nuri (Mosul)|Great Mosque of al-Nuri]] in [[Mosul]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/asia/2019/04/isil-chief-abu-bakr-al-baghdadi-appears-propaganda-video-190429163448332.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Hayat Tahrir al-Sham]] (HTS)  militants assault several [[Syrian Army]] positions in the northern [[Aleppo Governorate]], killing 17 soldiers and wounding 30 others. HTS say the attacks were in response to recent Syrian government and [[Russia]]n airstrikes on rebel-held areas. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/04/17-syria-pro-regime-fighters-killed-rebel-attacks-190427160246489.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Terrorism in the United States]]
**A [[United States Army|US Army]] veteran was planning to bomb a white nationalist rally in retribution for the [[Christchurch mosque shootings|shooting in New Zealand]]. He was also planning attacks on [[Jews]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48100431 (BBC)] [https://www.cnn.com/2019/04/29/politics/terror-plot-thwarted-la/index.html (CNN)]
;Arts and culture
*''[[Avengers: Endgame]]'' [[List of box office records set by Avengers: Endgame|breaks numerous box office records]], including the biggest opening weekend in cinematic history, grossing over $1 billion worldwide. [https://www.theguardian.com/film/2019/apr/28/avengers-endgame-breaks-global-box-office-record-in-opening-weekend (The Guardian)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Cyclone Kenneth]]
**The death toll in cyclone-hit northern [[Mozambique]] has risen to 38, as aid workers struggle to reach the worst-affected areas. Seven people were also killed by the cyclone in [[Comoros]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-48096148 (BBC)] [https://reliefweb.int/report/comoros/comoros-humanitarian-situation-report-no-2-cyclone-kenneth (ReliefWeb)]
*Floods sparked by torrential rains have killed 31 people in [[Indonesia]] while 13 others are missing. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/news/asean/1669084/floods-in-indonesia-kill-31-dozen-missing (Bangkok Post)]
*[[North Carolina]] authorities have ordered evacuations covering a half-mile radius because of air quality, possibly including harmful [[sulfuric acid]], from a massive fire at a metal recycling plant in [[Mooresboro, North Carolina|Mooresboro]]. Officials say the blaze has been extinguished, as of 7:15 a.m. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48095758 (BBC)]
*A minibus carrying Turkish [[Süper Lig]] [[Alanyaspor]] football players crashes near [[Alanya]], [[Turkey]], resulting in the death of [[Czech Republic national football team]] international [[Josef Šural]], while several other players are seriously injured. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2019/apr/29/josef-sural-czech-republic-killed-minibus-accident-alanyaspor-caulker-cisse (''The Guardian'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Indonesia]]n President [[Joko Widodo]] has decided to relocate the nation's capital from [[Jakarta]], on the northwest coast of [[Java]] island. The new location and timing are not yet known. Jakarta, home to over 10 million people, is sinking at one of the fastest rates in the world; almost half of its area is below sea level. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-48093431 (BBC)] [https://www.npr.org/2019/04/29/718234878/indonesia-plans-to-move-its-capital-out-of-jakarta-a-city-thats-sinking (NPR)]
*[[United States Deputy Attorney General|U.S. Deputy Attorney General]] [[Rod Rosenstein]]  announces he will resign, effective May 11. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/rod-rosenstein-to-resign-effective-may-11/2019/04/29/1092851c-6ac5-11e9-8f44-e8d8bb1df986_story.html?utm_term=.d3cd6724a20b (''The Washington Post'')]
